title: Relight
summary: Transform the lighting in any image — change direction, intensity, and mood while preserving the subject and composition. Image-to-image: pass `--image <path>` to the generator. Default direction is soft front; swap for chiaroscuro, dramatic side, rim backlight, golden hour, blue hour, moody noir, studio three-point, etc.
prompt: Relight the scene with soft front lighting, creating natural shadows and highlights while preserving the original subject and composition.
